findings.summary: page-settle.spec P3 asserts only the LOWER bound; spec 4.2 P3 requires < timeoutMs+500+250. Unit mutants X6 (settle object timeoutMs override ignored) and X5 (network-idle half not awaited) survive all 309 browser tests.
findings.note: live N18 / network-half cases in the builder harness would catch them; unit suite alone would not

findings.summary: Unit W16 covers the dialog gate only for text. Mutants X1 (js-only condition bypasses the dialog gate) and X2 (dialog grace never resets after a dialog is handled) survive.
findings.note: real code is correct live: js under an open alert fails in 1093 ms (A3)

findings.summary: 'fails within about a second' when a dialog blocks: true when the dialog is already open (1.08 s), but a dialog that opens during a pass takes pass bound + grace: up to ~2.7 s after the alert (bundle A3b: 3915 ms total, alert at ~1200 ms).

'the real total ... plus at most one 1.5 s probe pass' is understated on a hung main thread: the failure path also waits readTitleBounded (1.5 s). timeoutMs 0 returned at 3013 ms; 3000 -> 4622-4645 ms. Still bounded, never hangs.
Docs do not say a condition true for less than one poll (~100 ms) may be missed. A 30 ms flash was caught in the MCP run and missed in the bundle run.

H2 failed 1/20 in reruns because the OBSERVER could not reach cross-origin frame 5 (4 frames 'hung' to the oracle) while the product correctly reported text met; the label check then disagreed. A harness false-fail, not a product false-pass.
tools/list grows 94,285 -> 115,497 UTF-8 bytes (+21,212, +22.5%), 72 -> 73 tools; most of it is the settle description repeated on 22 more tools. Matches the builder's figure.

harness_change_assessment.0a3e467: LEGITIMATE premise check. The failing fresh-live H3 rows show observerTruth.before.hung=0 and after.hung=0 (the 'matrix-hang' frame answered 'shown'), so the product's textGone=met on 9/9 answered frames was TRUE at that moment. The fixture hangs only 30 ms after the frame's own load, after the old wait returned. The new check waits for the independent observer to see a hung frame and otherwise THROWS (recorded as FAIL, never skipped). Evidence: H1-H3 x10 runs x2 surfaces: H3 20/20 PASS, H1 20/20; live mutant X7 (hung frame counted as absent) -> H3 FAIL with the premise established, and my own independent A4/A5 probes FAIL too.
harness_change_assessment.6ba6dfd: LEGITIMATE. It only adds a no-settle control click to --baseline mode and a narrower pageFor URL; no product assertion changed. My independent T5 run reproduces the control (3064-3070 ms on both builds) and the hang (30370 ms on master).

gap_338_attribution: NOT FR2-08. Same machine, same load, run back to back: master 75b29c6 reproduced the stall: UC-12 'Click failed: Action click timed out after 15000ms', 225,937 ms (HEAD 226,581 ms); UC-05 285,707 ms on master (HEAD 342,843 ms); FR2-04 L13.headed.click-exit0 failed on MASTER (click timed out) and passed on HEAD. Code path: cmdClick, runtime.click and the engine click path are unchanged; the only engine change is the settle branch, not taken without --settle. The builder's '0 of 13 on master' was a sampling artefact. Pre-existing headed-click stall (GAP-316/GAP-321 family).
